docs.title: Welcome to Explore with AK
docs.text:
A personal knowledge base of everything technical — built in public, one topic at a time.

This space is where I break down complex ideas into simple, structured understanding — from low-level systems to high-level machine learning concepts.

docs.title: What you'll find here
docs.text:
• Linux & Kernel

    Explore how Linux actually works beneath the surface — from process management and memory handling to interrupts, scheduling, and kernel internals. Includes deep dives into system calls, device drivers, and hands-on kernel exploration.

    Explore

  • Mathematics

    Build the mathematical foundation required for computer science and machine learning. Covers topics like discrete mathematics, probability, linear algebra, and optimization — explained intuitively and practically.

    Explore

  • AI & Machine Learning

    Understand the core ideas behind AI and ML — from fundamental concepts to real-world implementations. Includes model architectures, algorithm breakdowns, research paper insights, and experiments.

    Explore

docs.title: How this is organised
docs.text:
This is not a static resource — it's a living knowledge system.

Notes here evolve continuously as my understanding deepens. Concepts are revisited, refined, and sometimes completely reworked.

Each topic typically follows a simple pattern:

  • Understand the core concept
  • Break it down into first principles
  • Reinforce it through examples or implementation
  • Document it clearly for future reference

Think of this less like a polished textbook and more like an open engineering notebook — raw, evolving, and honest.

"The best way to learn is to explain it to someone else."

docs.title: About Me
docs.text:
Hi, I’m AK.

I’m a software engineer focused on building a strong foundation in:

  • Systems (Linux Kernel, low-level programming)
  • Mathematics for computing
  • Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning

This project is my way of: - Learning deeply instead of superficially - Creating a long-term knowledge base - Sharing the journey publicly

If something feels incomplete, unclear, or evolving — that’s intentional. It reflects the process of learning in real time.
